visual_waivers.reason: D-83: measured 84.4 in round 2 on a production build (one run). Remaining gaps: the shared F-17/F-22/F-33 frame (top bar with the alerts bell, crumbs as a list, the History link, page width; Conflicts 11); stations drawn by the shared StationTrack with a status line under each name; the AgentCard head with no title and "step 4 of 4" from the steps sent (Conflicts 15). The Sources tags are now drawn in their tone (UI-1-2).

D-83: measured 75.6 in round 2 on a production build (one run). Remaining gaps: the shared frame (Conflicts 11); the station status lines; six table rows instead of three (Conflicts 2) with full amounts and the shared Unknown chip (Conflicts 1); the basis drawn whole without bold and the note label (Conflicts 6); the backend's consequence lines under the buttons.

D-83: measured 70.9 in round 2 on a production build (one run). Remaining gaps: the shared frame (Conflicts 11); the station status lines; the existing ReconcilePanel with three choices in the side column instead of the one Record button, and no Cancel delivery (Conflicts 3, 4); the banner without a bold lead (Conflicts 12); the shorter Next sentence (Conflicts 3). The Confirmation tag is now drawn in its tone (UI-1-2).

D-83: measured 55.6 in round 2 on a production build (one run). Remaining gaps: round 2 draws the board's dark six-cell strip and the caption (UI-1-1), but the strip now sits about 40px lower than the board's because the shared StationTrack draws a status line under each station name (frame, Conflicts 11), so a dark block lands on light board pixels and the score fell from 75.8 (when the figures were a white list). Other gaps: the shared frame (Conflicts 11); no Record actuals (Conflicts 5). Below the 70 floor: the gap is the frame's offset of a now-matching strip; asks a one-board floor exception (as D-112 for SCR-30-mobile-verified).

D-83: measured 83.1 in round 2 on a production build (one run). Remaining gaps: the shared phone frame and bar (Conflicts 11); the same sections and words as desktop in one column (Conflicts 10); the AgentCard (Conflicts 15).

D-83: measured 78.4 in round 2 on a production build (one run). Remaining gaps: the shared phone frame (Conflicts 11); the full-amount table scrolling in its own region, six rows (Conflicts 1, 2); the desktop basis, note and step labels in one column (Conflicts 9, 10).

D-83: measured 74.5 in round 2 on a production build (one run). Remaining gaps: the shared phone frame and the full item title on two lines (Conflicts 9, 11); the page now runs in the board's order (stations, banner, Delivery, Next, then the choices above the pinned button; UI-1-3), with the desktop Delivery facts and Next the board drops (Conflicts 10) and the existing ReconcilePanel's three choices instead of the one Record button (Conflicts 4).

D-83: measured 51.9 in round 2 on a production build (one run). Remaining gaps: round 2 draws the board's dark 3x2 strip and the caption (UI-1-1), but the full item title on two lines, the status tag and History (Conflicts 9, 11) push the strip about 70px below the board's, so the dark block lands on light board pixels and the score fell from 72.6; the desktop labels and "2 of 2" (Conflicts 9), the caption and Next the board drops (Conflicts 10). Below the 70 floor: the gap is the frame's offset of a now-matching strip; asks a one-board floor exception (as D-112 for SCR-30-mobile-verified).
